recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore valueset-expand-group to FHIR core unless a new work-group decision replaces FHIR-30702; any future changes to the retired Extension Pack artifact belong in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-16814 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked for support on ValueSet.compose.include to define abstract groupers and their member concepts or nested groupers, producing abstract ValueSet.expansion.contains entries for UI-oriented hierarchical expansions.
initial_application: Core commit c2bc0211921c8f7bbac3abeb6645aba6788402e2 (svn revision 14031) applied the issue by adding valueset-expand-group and valueset-expand-rules to the ValueSet extension spreadsheet and by linking those extensions from the ValueSet hierarchy narrative.
additional_context: The originating Zulip discussion distinguished the abstract grouping use case from inactive or historical-membership concerns tracked separately as FHIR-17276. Later published Vocab issues FHIR-30702 and FHIR-30703 resolved to remove valueset-expand-group and valueset-expand-rules because they were underspecified; commit 21e116ef55767a9a3f577976f0617889dfc527d9 removed the active core definitions, example, IG entries, and narrative links. FHIR-30700, FHIR-30702, and FHIR-30703 already have audit commits on the combined branch. The FHIR Extension Pack carries valueset-expand-group only as retired/deprecated external archival content.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active core ValueSet source is correct: it says CodeSystem and ValueSet.compose offer no direct support for defining hierarchies and groups, while ValueSet/$expand still allows servers to introduce groups from extensions or other knowledge. Restoring the old extension to core would conflict with later published Vocab decisions.
